allocation.rule: receipts are applied to invoices exactly as listed in invoice_refs
allocation.unreferenced: receipts with null invoice_refs are held in 2400 Unapplied Customer Receipts

fx.conversion: convert the document amount once and round to target minor units
fx.missing_date: use the latest published rate on or before that date
fx.quote: 1 unit of source_currency = rate units of target_currency
fx.rate_date: local date of the document in the company timezone
fx.receipts: AR is credited at the invoice carrying rate; the difference to cash at the receipt-date rate is booked to 7900 Realized FX Gain/Loss

duplicate_invoice.evidence: both invoice doc_ids and one posting row_id (AR debit or revenue credit) of each copy

payment_allocation.amount: amount of that payment booked to 2400 Unapplied Customer Receipts
payment_allocation.evidence: payment doc_id and its 2400 Unapplied Customer Receipts row_id

ledger.entries: rows of one journal entry share the same timestamp
ledger.null_references: missing references are null; links are never guessed

period.boundary: inclusive local dates in the company timezone

rounding.scope: each conversion, to target minor units
